raw: Agent Name: Planner, Step Number: 1, Reason for Mistake: Chose B by conflating increased normal force (and potential friction) with the actual stopping force; a vertical downward force does not directly decelerate horizontal motion—stopping requires a net force opposite the car’s motion (option D).
